description: This is a Java source file defining a helper class for logging, named 'Log'. It provides static methods for various log levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), and manages a chain of LogNode objects to delegate log output. The class also defines constants for log levels, and methods to set and get the LogNode, as well as convenience methods for each log level.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels and managing LogNode chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode.
